content:
tessa-cs: Dora from Acme reported 403s on rerank and embeddings after they were moved to SSO-provisioned service accounts. Attaching their repro.

dora-cust: Repro steps (from their CLI):
1) swap to SSO service account
2) run rerank request

curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_FROM_SSO>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"queries": ["q1"], "documents": ["d1","d2"]}'

Response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"token missing scope: rerank"}

dora-cust: Token metadata they pasted shows scopes: ["embeddings"] only. No rerank or generation.

infra-bot: Incident created #INC-4821 - 403 on rerank for org acme-corp after SSO provisioning.

tessa-cs: Confirming customer says this started immediately after we re-provisioned the service account via the SSO connector. They did not manually create keys.

liam-eng: Can you paste the SSO provisioning audit event? I want to see the mapped roles. If the provisioner dropped the "inference" role we need to know why.

paul-support: Pasting audit event from their tenant: 
{"provisioner":"sso-connector-v2","user":"sso:svc-acme","granted_roles":["vectors.read","svc.basic"]}

liam-eng: aha — granted_roles lacks any of the inference-related grants (rerank, embeddings.write, generate). Looks like the mapping rule for service accounts defaulted to a minimal set. This is a provisioning policy issue, not an API bug.

anne-sre: Short mitigation: customer can create a new API key from Console > Org Settings > API Keys and toggle the following scopes: embeddings:r, rerank:r, inference:call — then update their client. That's faster than waiting for provisioning fix.

dora-cust: I tried creating a console key with those scopes, replaced token in curl and rerank succeeded (200). So workaround works.

liam-eng: Root cause hypothesis: the SSO mapper respects explicit role mappings and a recent deploy changed the default mapping for SSO service accounts to exclude inference scopes. I'll git bisect the provisioner mapping and open a PR to restore the previous default.

tessa-cs: Customer wants a permanent fix so future re-provisions don't lose scopes. They also asked for a retroactive grant to existing SSO service accounts in their org.

liam-eng: Plan: (1) quick prod change to provisioner config to include inference grants for svc accounts (hotfix) — anne to deploy, (2) migration job to reconcile existing SSO-provisioned svc accounts and add missing scopes, (3) add an audit rule to warn on provision events that result in missing inference scopes.

anne-sre: I'll schedule the hotfix deploy at 15:00 UTC. Will post deploybot output here.

paul-support: Noted — I'll email Dora the temporary key approach and ETA for hotfix + migration.

infra-bot: deploybot: starting deploy of provisioner-config v2.3.1 to prod (hotfix) - tracking #DEP-1145

anne-sre: deploybot shows success in canary, rolling to 100% now.

infra-bot: deploybot: rollout complete.

liam-eng: After deploy I ran a small reconciliation script against acme-corp tenant and added rerank+embeddings to 3 svc accounts that were missing them. Script: 
```
for acct in $(list_sso_service_accounts org=acme-corp); do
  scopes=$(get_scopes $acct)
  if [[ ! "$scopes" =~ "rerank" ]]; then
    grant_scopes $acct rerank embeddings inference
  fi
done
```

paul-support: Dora confirmed after we added scopes her internal CI tests passed and the production job that uses rerank finished successfully. She said thanks and wants a short note for their SOC about what changed.

tessa-cs: I'll draft an email thread with timeline + actions (hotfix deploy, reconciliation, permanent mapping change) and send to Dora with CC to security.

dora-cust: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please put the reconciliation entry in our audit log so we can show it to our SOC.

liam-eng: Added reconciliation events to audit log for each account changed. Will follow up with the PR reference for the config change.

paul-support: Closing this escalation once Dora confirms SOC email satisfied.

dora-cust: Received the email and audit entries. All good from our side.

paul-support: resolved. :white_check_mark:
